name: How long does a typical heavy rain roof assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical heavy rain roof assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a heavy rain roof assessment typically ranges from 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on the size and complexity of your roof and the extent of the visible damage. A multi-story home with intricate rooflines or suspected widespread damage may require more time for a thorough evaluation. Our team strives to complete inspections efficiently while ensuring no detail is overlooked, providing you with prompt and accurate findings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assessments usually take 30 minutes to a few hours, varying with roof size and complexity, ensuring thoroughness.
